description: This file defines the class pBarcode39 used for creating and manipulating barcode images, specifically Code 39 barcodes. It includes methods for encoding data, calculating size, drawing barcodes, and reading barcode data from a database file.

classes.name: pBarcode39
classes.description: A class for generating and handling Code 39 barcodes, including encoding, size calculation, and drawing functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the barcode object, loads the barcode patterns from an external database file.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size (width and height) of a barcode for a given string and format.

methods.name: encode39
methods.description: Encodes an input string into Code 39 format and returns the encoded string with start/stop characters.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the barcode onto a given graphic object at specified coordinates with given formatting options.

methods.name: checksum
methods.description: Calculates a checksum character for a given string based on the Code 39 checksum algorithm.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Returns the leftmost number of characters from a string.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Returns the rightmost number of characters from a string.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns a substring starting at a specific position for a specified length.
